messages:
Alex: CI turned red on main right after the lockfile merge — pytest failure in tests/test_cache.py::test_kv_eviction
Alex: job: https://ci.redwood.example/4828 (failed)
ci-bot: build 4828 failed — pytest exited with 1. Logs attached.
Miriam: ugh, can someone bisect? sounds like a transitive bump from the merged lockfile.
Samir: I can look in ~30m. quick question — do we have the failing traceback in the logs?
Alex: yes, looks like an AttributeError coming from httpcore sync layer. pasted minimal trace below:
```
E   AttributeError: 'Response' object has no attribute 'stream'
.../site-packages/httpcore/_sync/connection.py:45 in request
```
Jen: heads-up — PR #345 changed the poetry.lock when resolving a merge conflict. I had to pick one version for httpcore/httpx.
Miriam: that would fit. which versions did the lock end up with?
Jen: httpcore 0.17.0, httpx 0.24.0 in the merged lock. previous main had httpcore 0.16.3.
Samir: I'll try a quick rerun with httpcore pinned back to 0.16.3 locally and also kick a debug CI job that overrides install.
Alex: commands that might help to reproduce locally:
```
git checkout main~1  # before the merge
cp poetry.lock poetry.lock.bak
git checkout <merge-commit> -- poetry.lock  # try versions from before/after
poetry install --no-dev
pytest tests/test_cache.py::test_kv_eviction -q
```
Samir: queued a debug rerun: https://ci.redwood.example/4829 (install forces httpcore==0.16.3).
ci-bot: debug rerun 4829 started.
Miriam: if that passes, we should pin in lockfile and open a follow-up to investigate why httpcore 0.17 breaks our usage.
Samir: update: debug rerun passed locally and CI debug 4829 is green. so likely a regression in httpcore 0.17.
Alex: ok short-term plan: Samir prepare a small PR that adjusts the lockfile to pin httpcore to 0.16.3 and include a note referencing the failing test. Long-term: allocate time to update httpx/httpcore usage.
Samir: creating PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/fix/lock-pin-httpcore (includes lockfile diff and CI green check).
Jen: thanks — after PR merges, let's add a follow-up (INFRA-482) to test compatibility with httpcore 0.17 and coordinate with SDK owners.
Miriam: sounds good. Samir — do you want a second pair of eyes on the PR before merge?
Samir: no need, I'll merge once CI on the PR is green and CI smoke passes. will ping if anything odd.
Alex: nice triage, thanks for the quick takeover :thumbsup:
Jen: noted in infra board and linked PR. closing this thread once PR is merged.
Samir: PR merged, main back to green. leaving the INFRA ticket for the follow-up.
Alex: closing loop — appreciate the quick response team.
